notes_context:
These notes were distilled from earlier work in this repository that passed verification. Follow them unless the code or CHANGELOG.md shows they no longer hold.
- [at-0003] Use BillingError with snake_case codes: Raise `ledgerly.errors.BillingError(code, detail)` with snake_case codes such as `invalid_state`, `invalid_quantity`, `negative_amount`; match the existing `invalid_state` message format `f"invoice {invoice.id} is {invoice.status}"`.
  (learned from task E02 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 1x, 1 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0001] Round money only with round_money: Always round monetary results with ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong invoice totals.
  (learned from task E01 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 1x, 1 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0002] Normalize money inputs with round_money before storing: Always pass monetary values through `ledgerly.money.round_money` before storing them on models or comparing against `ZERO`; never store raw input Decimals.
  (learned from task E02 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0004] Reject bools when validating integer arguments: When validating an integer parameter, exclude `bool` explicitly (`isinstance(x, bool) or not isinstance(x, int)`) because `True`/`False` are ints in Python.
  (learned from task E02 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 1x, 1 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0005] Normalize datetimes with ensure_utc: In ledgerly, normalize every incoming datetime with `ensure_utc` from `ledgerly.clock` before comparing or doing arithmetic (see `current_period` in `ledgerly/subscriptions.py`).
  (learned from task E03 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)

review_comments: [team convention] Every operation that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance must write an audit entry with ledgerly.audit.record("<past_tense_event>", <entity>_id=..., amount=...), where <entity> is the payment or invoice the money moves against (payment_id=... or invoice_id=...). Finance reconciles the ledger from these entries.

[team convention] Every operation that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance must accept an optional keyword-only `idempotency_key=None` (callers without a key keep working). Check the key first, before validating state: if an audit entry with the same key already exists (ledgerly.audit.events()), return the original result (for functions that return a record, the same record) without applying the operation again. Include `idempotency_key` in the audit entry you write. Introduced after the double-refund incident INC-204.

[team convention] Support-initiated refunds and credits above 500.00 need a second approver (finance policy FIN-2026-03): accept an optional keyword-only `approved_by=None` (callers that do not need approval keep working). Amounts at or below 500.00 need no approval; above it, raise BillingError("approval_required") when `approved_by` is missing.

item.title: Accept idempotency_key and check it first
